subject: English
title: CBSE English, Class X

source.read: Directorate of Education, Delhi: Class X English Language and Literature (184) annual syllabus 2025-26, which follows the CBSE curriculum (First Flight, Footprints without Feet)
source.note: UNOFFICIAL SOURCE. A state education department's copy of the CBSE syllabus, read through a text summary of the PDF. The board's prescribed chapters are named, not reproduced; the course is examined mainly through the textbooks, which are not in the app.

licence: Strand names as printed (facts). Every outcome is written by OpenPath in its own words; no curriculum or textbook text is reproduced.
review: OpenPath curriculum inventory (AI-assisted research from secondary sources; not an educator review)

outcomes.text: Reads a discursive passage of about 400 words and answers questions on it.
Reads a factual passage with a chart or data and answers questions.
outcomes.note: Reading passages have questions, and charts are read in Notes, charts and maps; long passages built on data are not yet in the app.

outcomes.text: Writes a formal letter on a given situation.
outcomes.note: Written here or on paper to a task set for this class. The learner checks it against a short list and a grown-up ticks what they see. The app does not keep or mark the writing; the essay studio gives a closer analysis where an evaluator is connected.

outcomes.text: Writes an analytical paragraph on a map, chart, graph or cues.
outcomes.note: A chart is read and an analytical paragraph about it put in order; a paragraph written freely is not marked.

outcomes.text: Makes the verb agree with its subject.
Reports commands, requests, statements and questions.
Fills gaps, edits and transforms sentences with correct grammar and punctuation.
Reads the prose and play of First Flight and answers questions on extracts and the whole.
outcomes.note: Long reads practise questions on theme, character and plot on OpenPath's own stories; the board's own textbook chapters are not in the app.

outcomes.text: Reads the poems of First Flight and explains their devices.
outcomes.note: Poems and everyday texts asks about purpose, point of view and figurative language on OpenPath's own poems; the textbook's poems are not in the app.

outcomes.text: Reads the stories of Footprints without Feet and writes about character and theme.
outcomes.note: Long reads practise questions on theme, character and plot on OpenPath's own stories; the board's own textbook chapters are not in the app.

outcomes.text: Speaks fluently and interacts well in role play, skits and talks.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Listens and answers questions on what is heard.
